markdown.markdown:
::: {.section #talks-overview} ::: {.container}
This page collects selected conference talks, posters, seminar talks, and workshops. The talks are centered around **algebraic topology**, **group theory**, **Lie algebras associated to groups**, **formality properties**, **resonance varieties**, **Chen ranks**, **configuration spaces**, and related topics. ::: ::: ::: {.section #featured-topics} ::: {.container} ## Featured Topic Areas ::: {.grid} ::: {.card} ### Formality Properties Talks on 1-formality, graded-formality, filtered-formality, rational homotopy theory, Malcev Lie algebras, and their applications to finitely generated groups. ::: ::: {.card} ### Resonance and Chen Ranks Presentations on resonance varieties, Chen ranks, Alexander invariants, cohomology jumping loci, and resonance--Chen rank formulas. ::: ::: {.card} ### Braid-Like Groups Talks involving pure braid groups, welded braid groups, McCool groups, configuration spaces, and algebraic invariants of braid-type groups. ::: ::: ::: ::: ::: {.section #conference-talks} ::: {.container} ## Conference Talks ::: {.links-list} ::: {.link-row}
The 8th International Conference on Matrix Analysis and Applications (ICMAA 2019)
University of Nevada, Reno, NV, July 15--18, 2019
Title: Matrix methods in algebraic topology
[Conference](https://wolfweb.unr.edu/homepage/ttam/2019-ICMAA.html)
::: ::: {.link-row}
AMS 2017 Fall Western Sectional Meeting
Special Session on Homotopy Theory, University of California, Riverside, November 4--5, 2017
Title: Formality properties: generalizations and applications
[Abstract](https://hewang.sites.northeastern.edu/files/2023/05/2017AMSabstract.pdf) · [Slides](https://hewang.sites.northeastern.edu/files/2023/05/2017AMSslides.pdf)
::: ::: {.link-row}
AMS 2016 Spring Eastern Sectional Meeting
Special Session on Topology and Combinatorics of Arrangements in honor of Mike Falk, Stony Brook University, March 19--20, 2016
Title: Towards a new resonance--Chen ranks formula: the case of welded braids
[Abstract](https://hewang.sites.northeastern.edu/files/2023/05/2016abstract.pdf) · [Slides](https://hewang.sites.northeastern.edu/files/2023/05/2016AMSslides.pdf)
::: ::: {.link-row}
